source_title: NASA’s Hubble Offers Cosmic Sampler of Targets for Roman
source_excerpt: A gallery of gravitational lenses captured by NASA’s Hubble Space Telescope showcases the diversity of this cosmic phenomenon and lays the groundwork for follow-up observations by the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope.
